title: Perinatal opioid exposure and maternal HCV infection impair microglia development and function: a patient-specific in vitro model.
description: Bulk RNASeq of umbilical cord blood mononuclear cell derived microglia like cells obtained from prenatal opioid exposed and naive neonates to infer the impact of prenatal opioid exposure on the functional landscape of microglia.

samples.title: Ctrl_NS
samples.description: Umbilical Cord Blood collected at delivery from healthy pregnancies. Cyropreserved in LN2, thawed and differentiated into microglia for 14 days.
